original_reference_rights: Underlying publications retain their own rights; no publisher text or table is redistributed.
source_type_notice: Compilation source-type codes are inventory leads only and are not evidence that NeqSim may dispatch a numerical coefficient.
identity_rule: Each row is matched by exact CAS to COMP.csv; formula and InChIKey are copied as audit identifiers, and missing identifiers remain missing rather than being inferred.
admission_rule: Every row remains unavailable to Henry correlation and reference-point dispatch until its required evidence is qualified.
uncertainty_and_range_rule: No uncertainty interval, pressure basis or finite validity range is inferred from compilation precision or source-type codes.

unqualified_hydrocarbon_source_inventory.definition_assessment: No selected type-L local temperature expression or campaign-qualified measured/reference-only fact establishes an intrinsic infinite-dilution water coefficient, units, pressure basis, uncertainty or validity range.
unqualified_hydrocarbon_source_inventory.required_evidence: A primary publication or redistributable measured dataset with exact identity, water solvent, intrinsic Henry convention, units, pressure and temperature conditions, uncertainty and finite validity range; a single value must use reference-temperature-only semantics.

solvent_role_polyol_nonempirical.definition_assessment: The estimate or other-source leads do not qualify an intrinsic infinite-dilution coefficient for the solute in water and cannot be transferred silently to mixed-solvent glycol solvent-role models.
solvent_role_polyol_nonempirical.required_evidence: A primary or redistributable measured dilute-solute-in-water dataset with explicit convention, units, pressure basis, uncertainty and range, followed by separate validation before any mixed-solvent glycol-model use.

database_identity_alias_requires_correct.definition_assessment: No Henry definition can be assigned while the component name conflicts with the stored TEG identity; the duplicate estimate inventory is not admissible evidence.
database_identity_alias_requires_correct.required_evidence: Correct the database identity first, then qualify a primary or redistributable measured water dataset for the corrected species with explicit Henry convention, units, conditions, uncertainty and finite validity scope.

reactive_inorganic_or_acid_speciation.definition_assessment: Effective aqueous uptake may include dissociation, hydrolysis, reaction, decomposition or unresolved molecular form and is not an intrinsic infinite-dilution neutral-species Henry constant.
reactive_inorganic_or_acid_speciation.required_evidence: Species-resolved primary measurements or a redistributable dataset with reaction/speciation model, pH or composition, Henry convention, units, conditions, uncertainty and finite validity range, while preserving existing reactive-model benchmarks.
